metadata.title: DataTree Hacks: How to Do Title Research and Hire Abstractor Services
metadata.author: REtipster
metadata.shortDescription:
Discounted Pricing to DataTree: https://retipster.com/go/datatree/yt-GfyX48eCbRY (REtipster affiliate link)
Full Blog Post: https://retipster.com/datatree-hacks/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=blog&utm_content=GfyX48eCbRY
Geo Coverage Map: https://web.datatree.com/home/geocoverage

Most people close the deal through a title company or real estate attorney when they buy real estate. In these cases, the title company will handle all the title research to verify that the property doesn't have any clouds on the title.

As a land investor, sometimes the purchase price is so low that it makes sense to close the deal myself. In these cases, I have to do my own title search and prepare all the documentation, which can be a slow, tedious process because I have to find a title abstractor who can pull all the documentation for me.

But did you know that DataTree can be used to handle this process in many areas around the country? I'll show you how it works in this video.

As I mentioned above, a title search requires a bit of understanding about what to look for. It's not something everybody is well suited to do, so if you have no idea how to do your own title search, then you're probably better off leaving this up to a professional abstractor to pull all the documents and review them to let you know if there are any issues you need to watch out for.

0:00 - Intro
0:21 - Using the GeoCoverage Map
1:40 - How to search for a property by the state, county, and name
1:50 - Reviewing a Transaction History Report
2:22 - How to order a Title Chain & Lien Report
3:48 - Reviewing a Title Chain & Lien Report
5:32 - Who uses DataTree? How to get a discount.
